Samir / Naomi,

Thanks — here's how Redwood will handle this from an accounting and posting perspective. TL;DR: we can do either credit memo or invoice offset; preferred for your case is invoice offset against INV-98765 if that invoice is outstanding.

Details: 
- Promotional allowance / trial credit policy: record as a contra-revenue (G/L 4005) when we document a one-time promotional allowance tied to a commercial amendment.
- Credit memo: generates an AR credit in the subledger referencing the original account and amendment. This is useful if MerchantCo wants a formal credit instrument for internal controls.
- Invoice offset: we apply a negative line against the specified invoice number; on our side we still create a journal entry that debits Sales Revenue and credits AR (or posts to contra-revenue depending on revenue recognition timing). Requires the target invoice number and confirmation that the invoice is still unpaid or can be reissued.

What I need to proceed:
1) Confirm "Invoice offset" and provide the target invoice number (INV-98765 noted).
2) Confirm MerchantCo tax ID and billing contact email for our AR notes.
3) Complete the attached journal_entry_template.csv (example rows included).

Attachments: journal_entry_template.csv (please return after filling).

If for any reason the offset can't be applied (invoice already reconciled), we will issue a credit memo and include a cross-reference to INV-98765.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
